summary: Make MemoryStorage (and all storages) atomic for update/remove/insert_multiple so a failing write leaves data unchanged, and keep query cache consistent with stored data after any write.

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.update(delete('tmp')) is called and raises KeyError
acceptance_criteria.then: db.all() returns [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}] (unchanged) and the KeyError propagates

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with JSONStorage (temp file) containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.update(delete('tmp')) is called and raises KeyError
acceptance_criteria.then: db.all() returns [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}] (unchanged) and the JSON file content is unchanged

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.remove(Query().tmp.exists()) is called and raises KeyError (if it does) or any exception during the operation
acceptance_criteria.then: db.all() returns the original data unchanged and the exception propagates

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.insert_multiple([{'name': 'b'}, {'invalid': 'doc'}]) raises an exception (e.g. validation error if added, or simulate failure on second doc)
acceptance_criteria.then: db.all() returns [{'name': 'a'}] (unchanged) and the exception propagates

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage and default cache_size containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) is called, then db.update(delete('tmp')) raises KeyError
acceptance_criteria.then: a subsequent db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) returns [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}] (reflecting unchanged stored data) without calling db.clear_cache()

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage and default cache_size containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) is called, then db.update(set('tmp', 2)) succeeds
acceptance_criteria.then: a subsequent db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) returns [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 2}] (reflecting updated stored data) without calling db.clear_cache()

acceptance_criteria.when: import tinydb; from tinydb import TinyDB, Query, Table; from tinydb.storages import Storage, JSONStorage, MemoryStorage; from tinydb.middlewares import Middleware
acceptance_criteria.then: all public classes and methods exist with the same signatures as before the fix (no API removals or signature changes)

assumptions.assumption: Maintainer considers the half-modified MemoryStorage behaviour a bug
assumptions.default_used: Yes, it is a bug (issue frames it as unexpected and inconsistent with JSONStorage)

assumptions.assumption: Atomicity is achieved by copying data before mutation and restoring on exception
assumptions.default_used: Copy-on-write / transaction-style rollback in Table._write or Storage.write

assumptions.assumption: Cache invalidation happens in Table after Storage.write succeeds (or is skipped on failure)
assumptions.default_used: Invalidate _cache in Table after successful write

assumptions.assumption: JSONStorage already satisfies atomicity and cache consistency
